evidence.quote: That’s why today we’re releasing a family of seven new world class models at a truly exceptional price-performance.
MAI Code 2 and MAI Code 2 Flash: two new coding models built for everyday enterprise coding tasks, delivering leading performance at a fraction of the cost of competing models.
Microsoft announced seven new MAI models at Ignite on Nov. 17, covering coding, cyber defense, image generation, live voice, medical transcription and model routing [1].

Microsoft says MAI Code 2 reaches about 98% of OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Sol on coding benchmarks at about 40% of its price, and 96% of Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5 at about 5% of the price; it is live in GitHub Copilot [1][2].
MAI Code 2 reaches 98% of the coding quality of GPT-6.1 Sol at about 40% of the price. And against Opus 5.5, it reaches 96% performance for just 5% of the price.
